decision: no new six-arm natural rerun in this correction round; structural reachability proof retained
basis: The six retained Phase2 final3 natural payloads are six resident courses: each has 10,800 daily rows and 120 seasonal rows, and every serialized daily band row remains phase residential; no fission/provisional transition is present in the retained instrument.

The instrument does not serialize hungerClassification, nutritionCoverage, or knownPopulationFraction in daily/seasonal rows. Their absence is therefore not treated as proof that those states never occurred.

The structural reachability audit proves the relevant producer/query/order invariants: every retained seasonal row has dated finite support/demand with one or more measured segments at days 90..10800; residential daily production runs before the seasonal compatibility tick; demography calls the annual reader from the annual band path; the pipeline reaches demography before ecology depletion; exposure intervals carry physical start/end chronology and reject overlap; annual nutrition queries the previous 360 completed physical days; recovery maturity is >=1 season (90 qualifying days) and partial known body-time is excluded from recovery.

The serialized fields are intentionally not used to infer coverage or classifications. The ordinary residential producer defaults to full body-time; the changed coverage branches require a partial known-population input or an explicit shifted currentDay, and those paths are exercised by the controlled coverage/shifted annual audit. The ordinary residential annual semantics are separately covered by the 120-year three-scenario oracle and the 48-row full-known compatibility vector.
No natural result is used as acceptance or population-growth evidence.
